changes: MetaDB now asks the store through the extension instead of through its own server, so pages load the same but nothing goes through the site's relay. Only MetaDB's pages can use this, only for Meta's store, and no cookies are sent.
Requests go out as a headset's app manager would send them, like before. Adds the "declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess" permission, which sets that one header.
